statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains in the low band: the index sits near a fresh session high, but a retracement has already printed, volatility is decaying and both yields and crude are easing.
recommendation: Tail holds below the watch threshold on an orderly path in which a genuine 200-point retracement has already occurred within this window. The 13:30Z U.S. cash open remains the narrow evidence-based checkpoint, where a record-high entry with cooperative yields and crude could begin to deny retracement.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures print a fresh 31,539.00 high while the ten-year eases to 5.268% and Brent slips to $97.52; Tail stays low at 16 and Stress eases to 45.
body: NQ December futures trade at 31,527.50, up 209.75 or 0.67%, roughly twelve points below a 31,539.00 session and 52-week high set this morning, above the prior 31,317.75 close. The 31,339.00 session low, and a wider 31,309.25 overnight low on the Yahoo Finance session window, confirm a genuine retracement of about 200 points has already printed inside this assessment window. Cash NASDAQ-100 closed Monday at 31,076.44, up 0.87%, a record, with Monday's 31,117.36 high also the 52-week high. VIX is 15.30, down 0.22 or 1.42%, trading near the low of its 15.28-15.52 range after a 15.52 close. Cross-asset conditions continue to relieve rather than amplify. The ten-year Treasury yield is 5.268%, down about 4.5 basis points from a 5.313% close and well off the 5.329% session high that marked the highest level since 2002; the thirty-year has retreated to 5.626% from a 5.702% peak, and the two-year sits at the 4.83% of the latest H.15 release dated 2026-10-02. Treasury Secretary Bessent publicly committed to bending the debt trajectory, though analysts note the deficit is near 6% of output with no concrete reduction plan, so the statement alone is unlikely to reverse the selloff. Brent at $97.52 and WTI at $86.97, both down about 2.8%, extend a multi-session decline as Middle Eastern exports recover toward pre-war levels and the G7 releases 100 million barrels from emergency reserves. The Strait of Hormuz remains closed pending Iran's stated conditions, with an Iran-Oman corridor near final but short of normal transit; that is a persistent condition rather than new escalation. Rate expectations have softened further, with roughly a 78% probability of the Federal Reserve holding this month after a soft September payrolls report. Against the single genuine Tail amplifier of an index trading within twelve points of a fresh record-area high stand a decaying VIX, an already-printed retracement, easing yields and crude, and conspicuously unaligned internals: Monday brought only 47 Nasdaq new highs against 216 new lows, and the PHLX Semiconductor Index fell about 0.7% while the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.8%, only the second such divergence of 2026. Premarket leadership is megacap-led and narrow, with Microsoft, Tesla, Meta and Nvidia higher while Intel and Micron trade lower. The shared Finviz context file was last collected on 2026-09-29 and is therefore stale under the 90-minute freshness contract, so it was not used as evidence; the assessment rests on independently verified primary sources. Tail is held at 16 with the conditional lift confined to the opening auction and the power hour.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry published Claude assessments. Tail entered the window at 7 on Monday midday, climbed through the U.S. session to a 20 peak at 19:00Z as the index pushed to a record close, the only watch-band reading of the window, then decayed overnight into an 8-12 band. It firmed again through the European morning to 13 at 10:00Z and 15 at 11:00Z as futures pushed to a new session high. Stress held a 45-55 elevated band and eased toward its lower edge overnight; Confidence stayed in a tight 86-89 range. Mode alternated between mixed and trend-up, with one normal reading at the start of the window.
outlookSummary: The orderly path is expected to persist through the remainder of the European morning with Tail held at 16. Risk stays concentrated in the narrow 13:30Z-15:00Z U.S. opening window, where the index would enter the auction near a fresh record-area high with yields and crude both cooperating; conditional Tail is lifted to 18-19 there and again to 19 into the 19:00Z power hour, the joint peaks of the window, before easing to 17 through the 20:00Z cash close. Conditional Tail then decays to a 10-11 floor across the Asian session before a measured climb back to 15 a day on. Every forecast hour stays below the watch threshold, so the mapped policy state remains EA_ON across the window. Stress eases to a 43-49 band, marginally lower than the previous assessment because the long end has retreated further from its 2002 high and Brent has slipped to $97.52, but still elevated because a 5.27% ten-year, a closed Strait of Hormuz and conspicuously narrow index leadership are unchanged. Confidence tapers from 88 to 77 with horizon decay. Scheduled catalysts beyond the window, notably the September FOMC minutes at 2026-10-07T18:00Z and the 10-Year Note auction an hour earlier, are carried in the event calendar rather than scored into any forecast slot.
